spells.name: Ember Bolt

effect.verb: hurls a crackling ember bolt at

spells.desc: Hurl a focused spark at a frontline foe for 1d10 + INT mod + 2 fire damage (1 Stamina).

spells.name: Wayfarer Aegis

effect.verb: raises a lantern-gold ward around you

spells.desc: Wrap yourself in a lantern-gold barrier granting +7 Arcane Ward and restoring 5 Health (1 Stamina).

spells.name: Coastal Gale Wave
spells.desc: Unleash a sweeping salt-wind wave striking every enemy in both frontline and backline rows for 1d8 + INT mod + 2 damage (2 Stamina).
